name: git_cochange
description: Git churn (commits per file) and co-change pairs (files committed together) for bug localization

path.description: repository or subdirectory to analyze (default: project root)

files.description: seed files: only pairs involving them (repo path, project path or basename)

n.description: non-merge commits to look at, newest first (default 400)

limit.description: churn rows and pairs to return (default 20)

cochange.support: num 0..1 = count / min(commits of a, commits of b)
